title: On Sharing the last loaf with three children
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：share　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 share 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the musician ① shared the last loaf with three children on the same day, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the musician ② shares the last loaf with three children before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ share the last loaf with three children at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ shared the last loaf with three children before — a line in the programme for December 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sharing the last loaf with three children on the same day, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ share the cost among six families before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Share the cost among six families at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new listener from the next hall ⑧ shares the cost among six families on the same day every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the piano, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ shared the last loaf with three children again when nobody else would.

⑩ To share the last loaf with three children, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the hall remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the hall forgets, somebody shares the last loaf with three children before dawn again and somebody must share the last loaf with three children on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 分享（一般过去式 shared the last loaf with three children：1973 年乐师头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 分享（一般现在 shares the last loaf with three children：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 分享（不定式 to share the last loaf with three children：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 分享（过去完成时 had shared the last loaf with three children：1967 年十二月的节目单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 分享（动名词 sharing the last loaf with three children 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 分担（share the cost among six families：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去分担让六家人分担这笔花销）
G. v. 分担（share the cost among six families：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 分享（后段两处：新来的听客照例 shares the cost among six families，而母亲又一次 shared the last loaf with three children）

answers.why: share 意为“分享”，1973 年乐师当天就分享把最后那条面包分给三个孩子，那是音乐厅里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 shared。
share 意为“分享”，自那以后乐师天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 shares。
share 意为“分享”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯分享把最后那条面包分给三个孩子”，此处为不定式 to share the last loaf with three children。
share 意为“分享”，节目单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人分享过，故用过去完成时 had shared。
share 意为“分享”，乐师说“分享把最后那条面包分给三个孩子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 sharing the last loaf with three children 作主语。
share 意为“分担”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去分担让六家人分担这笔花销”，should ever 之后用原形 share the cost among six families。
share 意为“分担”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻分担让六家人分担这笔花销（share the cost among six families at once），以后再也不要提起。
share 意为“分享”，新来的听客每个夜晚都照例分担让六家人分担这笔花销，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 shares。
share 意为“分享”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就分享把最后那条面包分给三个孩子，用一般过去式 shared 叙述。
share 意为“分享”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要分享把最后那条面包分给三个孩子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和音乐厅记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 share 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the musician shared the last loaf with three children on the same day, and nobody in the hall forgot it.
Even now the musician shares the last loaf with three children before dawn whenever the hall asks.
Sharing the last loaf with three children on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever share the cost among six families before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next hall shares the cost among six families on the same day every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother shared the last loaf with three children again, and the hall remembered that half.
